sources.finding: The reviewed October 2026 EMDA, fees and conditional waiver do not establish an unconditional zero-cost grant for public OHLCV storage, display and prediction use. Existing completed research is reused.

The official site offers end-of-day instrument data. A legacy agreement discusses after-midnight redistribution, but it does not prove the scope of current endpoint archival and platform rights under the later reviewed Euronext documents.

The published grant is personal and non-commercial unless separately agreed in writing. The definition includes organizational use and provision to other users. No account, API key or agreement was created.
Sections 2.2 through 2.4 condition external display and redistribution on express entitlement, and restrict commercial Free Tier use. No account or paid add-on was created.

Both official pages returned a JavaScript browser-verification wall to the read-only lookup. Secondary claims about restrictions are not treated as primary permission evidence. No challenge bypass or bulk retrieval was attempted.

57 existing identity-bound owner archive documents were read; only complete positive OHLCV observations are restored. Original source observations, including all excluded references, are retained in proof. This is not a new provider license or proof of independent total-return suitability.
